notes.title: Wyld Land Beta 3 x No Time to Loot
notes.notes:
[p]Hey folks! We’re coming at ya with another open beta and this time we are doing it with the Human Qube folks as we participate in the [b]No Time to Loot festival![/b] On the menu we have new classes, a new “Boss Rush” mode,  new gun archetypes, updated guns, new bosses and more! You’ll have access for a whole week starting today until September 29th! So excited for you all to see what we’ve been cooking up! If you’re interested you can read a more in depth look at our updates below!
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45342732/1f0e87daaca264a1d0e4fb16a37dc168db4263d1.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]New Classes[/b][/p][p]The community has been asking for Classes for a long time and we are proud to say that we have three out of the four planned classes available to test in this upcoming playtest. Each of the classes will now have their own dedicated Echo path and items to make the gameplay of each feel more unique.
[/p][list][*][p]Tank: A slow moving class with high health that allows the use of the taunt ability so that enemies follow and direct attacks at it instead of it’s allies.[/p][/*][*][p]Disruptor: A fast moving class with low health that allows players to add debuffs and status effects to enemies.[/p][/*][*][p]Support: Another fast moving class that allows players to regenerate health and stamina more quickly while also providing buffs like doing more damage or moving more quickly.
[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Active Item Updates and Additions[/b][/p][p]For a while the only active item that folks really used was Medical Spa, but with our new class system we have created several new ones whose abilities synergize with their class. These 8 new active items items will be able to be used by everyone but their reach and duration increase as you make your way up each class’s Echo tree. We have also tuned how Medical Spa works so that you no longer get an instant heal upon use, but instead receive a heal over time effect. 
[/p][p][i]Hint: Best way to find these is by defeating our updated world events.[/i][/p][p]
[b]Boss Rush Shards[/b][/p][p]You’ve been asking for a while now for a better method to grind for exotics and items on specific bosses, and we’re giving you that with our new Boss Rush Shards. Now, when you defeat a T10 Corruption Boss, you’ll receive a T10 Corruption Shard for another random dungeon (like usual). But you’ll also receive a T1 Corruption Shard for that same dungeon with the Boss Rush mutation. With this mutation, as you scale up the ladder from T1 to T10, you’ll continue to receive a shard for the same dungeon, until you complete T10, at which point you will not receive a shard.[/p][p][/p][p]What this means is that if you are able to defeat a dungeon at T10, you can replay that dungeon 10 times, getting 10 chances at boss-specific loot for that dungeon as you climb the ladder. That should give a lot more opportunities to get that specific exotic item or class item you’re after![/p][p][/p][p][b]Reduced Gun Archetypes[/b][/p][p]Previously, we had 11 gun archetypes in the game, but the feedback from you all helped us realize there is too much overlap between archetypes, which makes a few of them less valuable. We’ve pared it down to 6 gun archetypes in an attempt to make each viable for different situations and play styles.
[/p][p]Primary Type: With medium to fast reload speeds and the ability to do consistent damage, we are thinking players will consider using these options in the first gun slot.[/p][list][*][p]Handguns: Long ranged weapons with high powered single or double bullet projectiles (replaces blasters, pistols and revolvers).[/p][/*][*][p]Shotguns: Short ranged weapons that focus on maximizing its projectile spread by getting up close and personal with enemies ensuring as many of its projectiles hit as possible.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Automatics: Mid ranged weapons with high fire speed where players try to mow down players (replaces assault rifles and smgs). [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Secondary Type: High damage weapons with passive reload – we are thinking these are weapons players will consider using in the 2nd and 3rd gun slots. [/p][list][*][p]Explosive Launchers: Very powerful short ranged guns with large bullet projectiles with passive reload.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Lasers: Very powerful piercing mid-ranged laser streams (no longer have to pause movement when shooting).[/p][/*][*][p]Long Ranged Rifles: Very powerful piercing long ranged guns with fast moving projectiles.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][b]Gun Updates[/b][/p][p]We have been listening to your feedback on our guns. From making legendary and exotic weapons more viable, to new sprites, we have attempted to make positive upgrades on many fronts.
[/p][p][b]Community Bosses[/b][/p][p]France and Anthoney have created two new bosses for the game and they will be ready to test in this upcoming Beta! Like the original Dark Hunter, the entrances to these boss rooms will drop randomly in T10 zones in the Overworld. By defeating them, you can receive a T20 Shard for the boss to take it on the highest level.[/p][list][*][p]Harbinger of Storms: Created by AntHoney and designed for late game. A difficulty comparison would probably be between the two hunter bosses (potentially harder than Young Hunter but potentially easier than the Dark Hunter).[/p][/*][*][p]Idrae: Created by France as the most difficult boss in the game thus far![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We’ve spread some fun exotics onto these bosses, and there are also unique pets to earn as well as Achievements and Titles. So go and challenge yourself to see if you can beat the toughest test the community has to offer thus far![/p][p]
[b]Updated World Events[/b][/p][p]In our last Beta not many folks interacted with our world events due to bugs and lack of unique loot for beating them. We are proud to say the bugs have been fixed and running world events is likely the most effective way to quickly find the new class items in the game![/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Beta 2: Update 1
notes.notes: [p]The second Beta Test for Wyld Land launched just a few days ago! [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3387720?emclan=103582791474864140&emgid=543361383085900544"]Click here to view the new additions to the game[/url]. Since then, we have been focused on fixing issues and increasing stability for the test.[/p][p]The switch to our new engine had a few issues. We think we've tackled the main connection and game breaking issues. Thank you everyone for your patience while we addressed these issues and got the game running smoothly again! As of now we still have a few bugs still to address, but the game should be running much closer to the previous build with improved network stability.[/p][p]You can report bugs here on Steam or join our [url="https://discord.com/invite/7yPh4FYXyu"]Discord[/url]![/p][p]Here are the changes and bug fixes we have made since Beta 2 was launched.[/p][h3][b]Elite Enemies[/b][/h3][p]We heard the feedback on the new enemy variants. These variants should feel better to fight in groups and within Corrupted Dungeons.[/p][p]The new [b]Elite Assassin[/b], [b]Elite Dual Slicer[/b], and [b]Elite Bomb Bot [/b]were incorrectly flagged as Elite enemy types so they had more health and were doing more damage than intended. Those are now Normal enemies again. The idea is these tougher variants have more difficult mechanics/attack patterns, but they should still not be true Elites for balancing purposes.[/p][p][b]Elite Assassin:[/b][/p][list][*][p]No longer teleports.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Elite Bomb Bot:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Slower movement speed.[/p][/*][*][p]Longer cooldown between explosive trail abilities.[/p][/*][*][p]Bomb eruption ability is weaker.[/p][/*][*][p]The size of the bomb eruptions circle has been decreased.[/p][/*][*][p]The damage potency of the bullets after the eruption has been decreased.[/p][/*][*][p]The Elite Bomb Bot will have to get closer to you before it explodes.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Elite Dual Slicer:[/b][/p][list][*][p]No longer teleports.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased cooldown on abilities.[/p][/*][*][p]Decreased the number of bullets coming from its abilities.[/p][/*][*][p]Decreased the speed of bullets.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Elite Heavy Slicer:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Lower number of bullets with an increased spread for Apex Slice ability.[/p][/*][*][p]Lower number of bullets for Whirling Blades ability.[/p][/*][*][p]Lower number of bullets in the Blade Charge Wave ability.[/p][/*][*][p]No longer has the chance to teleport.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Elite Turtle:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Longer cooldowns between abilities.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Elite Lumbering Hulk[/b][/p][list][*][p]Increased cool down of abilities.[/p][/*][*][p]Decreased damage potency of abilities.[/p][/*][*][p]Decreased the number of bullets from the Elite Cleave ability.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Raid Adjustments[/b][/h3][p]We are continuing to improve performance and tuning for our first two raid bosses. Thank you to everyone who has tested the raid and helped provide feedback so we can fix bugs and the tuning to where it should be![/p][list][*][p]Improved performance for raids.[/p][/*][*][p]Group scaling when in the Raid is now a fixed value (applies to both trash and boss rooms). It's tuned down from what it would have been with 6 people, but mobs are still tougher than those in normal dungeons. At the same time, it's now always beneficial to bring a full group to the Raid as the mobs will be the same amount of difficulty regardless of the number of players present.[/p][/*][*][p]The green circle pools in the Raid have had their tick value increased, so you should get the buff more quickly without needing to stay in there as long. In addition, you should now get the tick even if you dash through the circle when it is trying to give the buff.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Boss Hitbox Fix[/b][/h3][p]We fixed the hitboxes for the following bosses:[/p][list][*][p]Mind Flayer[/p][/*][*][p]Widow[/p][/*][*][p]Inferno Juggernaut[/p][/*][/list][p][b]General Bug Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Several fixes have been added to address performance and stability. Thank you to everyone who reported issues, it helped us solve many of these bugs quickly![/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the player’s body would disappear.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where setting the game to full screen would cause slowdown.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the Dash tab of the Collections screen not working properly.[/p][/*][*][p]An error message now shows when you try and infuse an item into itself.[/p][/*][*][p]Corrupted Bullets are now more visible.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the recipe for the boss favors to correctly use Refined Wyld Luck.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug which was keeping carp from spawning correctly. They will appear when using an Advanced Lure in T9+ zones.[/p][/*][*][p]Added new experimental rendering mode to the engine which should have greatly improved performance when several of the same enemy type are on the screen at once (e.g. in the Raid). For now, it’s only enabled for a small group of relevant enemies, but if it works well, we’ll roll it out to all enemy types.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the issue where Collections screen wasn't showing previews anymore.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the bug where the chest screen would scroll back to the top every time you moved/changed something.[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][p] [/p]

notes.title: Beta 2 Now Live!
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello Runners![/h2][p][/p][h3]The Wyld Land Beta Test #2 is now live![/h3][h3]Visit the main Steam Store page to play! This Beta Test will run until July 11th![/h3][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3387720/Wyld_Land/"][/dynamiclink]  [/p][h3][url="https://steamcommunity.com/games/3387720/partnerevents/preview/543361383085900544" style="button"]You can view the patch notes for the beta test here![/url][/h3][p]
If you are new around here, [b]Wyld Land is a free-to-play bullet hell MMO.[/b] You can play right here on Steam, or you can actually play in your browser on basically any PC. [url="https://wyld.land/"]If your someone who would like that, simply head over to our website to play in your browser by clicking here.[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Our first beta test had about 3000 players join and create accounts! For this new test, we added raiding, fishing, crafting, harvesting, and more. We are also running the game on a new engine, so please report your bugs and issues so we can fix them![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45342732/fae87257a98ba1c7d688c5db65b74e1a75c09868.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We're building Wyld Land to be about collecting loot, slaying tough bosses, and playing with your friends. Wyld Land won't be about killing your wallet. There will be a non-predatory battle pass but you'll be able to enjoy the experience completely free-to-play! If this sounds good, you can hop into the beta right now to play![/p][p][/p][p]You can also join the Discord and follow us across social media to keep up with development:  [/p][p][url="discord.gg/6GXWp8UPf5"]Discord[/url] [/p][p][url="https://www.youtube.com/@NullEq"]YouTube[/url] [/p][p][url="https://x.com/WyldLandGame"]Twitter/X[/url] [/p][p][url="https://bsky.app/profile/wyldland.bsky.social"]BlueSky[/url] [/p][p][url="https://www.tiktok.com/@wyldland"]TikTok[/url]  [/p][p][/p][p]The best way to support the development of Wyld Land currently is to Wishlist the game here on Steam (yes, it really does help!) and invite your friends to play with you.[/p][p]Thanks for supporting the development of Wyld Land. [/p][p]See you in game, Runner!  [/p][p][b]-The Wyld Land Team[/b] [/p]

notes.title: Beta Test 2 Patch Notes
notes.notes: [p]Welcome to Wyld Land Beta 2! We're so excited to welcome you back to the Wyld. Note that as before, there will [i]not[/i] be a data wipe until the end of the Beta period, and we will have at least one more Beta test after this one. Let's start with the major additions and then we'll cover the smaller changes. [b]New Engine[/b] First off, we're rolling out our brand-new client engine for the game, which is based on [url="https://heaps.io/"]Heaps[/url].[/p][p]This engine is built from the ground-up to be lighter and faster so you should see even better performance as well as faster load times. For example, if you're playing in your web browser, the initial download size to get to the login screen has gone down from 14MB to about 2MB! Note that with the new engine in place, you will need to re-bind any keys that you have changed from the default! We welcome your feedback on the new engine, and let us know if you run into any bugs or other issues that weren't there before so we can get them fixed ASAP! Using the new engine should be largely seamless, but here are a few quality of life changes that we've added since the last test you might notice:[/p][list][*][p]The Inventory layout has changed, and now if you have the Pack Rat or Bank Rat Echoes unlocked, it's all one long scrollable pane, instead of needing to click through pages.,[/p][/*][*][p]The Infusion panel has moved to the top-left when it's open, and hopefully the descriptions of what's going on are now more useful.,[/p][/*][*][p]There's a new Status Effects panel on the left-hand side of the screen that will show you all effects on your character as well as their name and remaining duration. In addition, when you have status effects we'll now hide the Nameplate to show the effect icons (since you probably want to know about those more than you want to be reminded about your name!),[/p][/*][*][p]Scrolling throughout the UI should feel much better now and work better with mouse scroll wheels. Note that we removed using the mouse scroll wheel to switch weapons, use Tab or the 1, 2, and 3 keys (or setup your own keys in the Keybinds).[/p][/*][*][p]There are now unique tile sets for the Dungeons in the game, and you'll see those when entering the dungeon. Note that each tile set is shared among ~3 dungeons right now, but we're going to work on adding more to the game!,[/p][/*][*][p]Chat messages now fade from view after a short period of time, and will re-appear when you focus the Chat Input.,[/p][/*][*][p]The Stamina bar for the player has been re-worked and is now easier to see and appears below the player as a straight bar with segments rather than a radial bar.,[/p][/*][*][p]Dungeon entrances will now show the number of players that are in the dungeon currently, as well as the max players allowed in that dungeon. For Raids, it's 6 players, for other dungeons, it's 30 players.,[/p][/*][/list][h2]The Raid [/h2][p]Our first Raid content, titled for now simply The Raid, is available in this test. Raids are the most challenging content in the game, and we're designing them to require a coordinated group that's willing to communicate and work together to overcome them. We want Raid content to feel difficult but fair, and we look forward to receiving your feedback about where we're hitting or missing the mark in that regard. A few [b]important things to note[/b] before you jump in (seriously, please read this):[/p][list][*][p]Raid content is designed for [b]6 players[/b]. The fights have mechanics that expect this number of players. If you attempt to go into the Raid with fewer than 6 players, you will likely be unable to complete them.,[/p][/*][*][p]Raid content has mechanics that if done improperly [b]will kill you[/b]. We highly recommend that until you understand the fights and what is required from the mechanics, you do not risk your best gear.,[/p][/*][*][p]In order to access the Raid, you must complete all of the quests from the NPCs in Haven, starting with the Elio Voss quest chain (which you may have already completed in the last test, if so talk to "Ghost", the guy with all the masks in the bottom of Haven).,[/p][/*][*][p]After you've completed those quests, you'll be able to get a Raid Portal Doohickey from Ezekiel Thornwood whenever you'd like. Using that will spawn a Raid portal just like any other dungeon.,[/p][/*][*][p]However, if you try to access the Raid portal (even if someone else spawns it) and you haven't completed those quests, you will be [i]unable to enter the Raid[/i]. You must be "Attuned" to the raid to access it. So keep that in mind.,[/p][/*][*][p]Right now the Raid has two bosses. You must complete the first boss in order to unlock the pathway to the second boss. Each boss has a new unique Exotic item that can drop as well as a mini-pet you can acquire. Note that the Exotic chances on the Raid bosses are higher than those on normal bosses since you can't just farm them repeatedly (see below).,[/p][/*][/list][p] A note on [b]Raid Lockouts and Loot[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]The game keeps track of what bosses in the Raid you have killed this week. You only get [i]one loot chance per week per boss[/i], regardless of how many times you kill the boss. So you can help others by killing the boss multiple times, but you yourself can only get one chance at loot (the first time each week you kill it). This is known as your Raid Lockout.,[/p][/*][*][p]In addition to that, if you spawn the Raid portal and enter it, and if you've already killed the first boss, the first boss will already be dead in the Raid, and the pathway to the second boss will be open. If others then join your Raid portal, that's what they'll see as well. (Essentially, the Raid Lockout of the person who spawns the portal is what determines what bosses are available in the Raid to start).,[/p][/*][*][p]The person who spawned the Raid portal also has to be present in the Raid and participate in the kill when a boss dies in order for the next pathway to open.,[/p][/*][*][p]Raid Lockouts reset each week at 12:01AM US Central Time Monday morning.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Collections Screen [/h2][p]New in this test is the Collections Screen (J). This is a handy place where we now store all of the various collectibles you can unlock in the game, including Pets, Dashes, Teleports, Titles, and Exotics.[/p][list][*][p]Now for Pets, Dashes, and Teleports, when you receive the item, just hold down the Q key to use it and it will be added to your Collection and unlocked permanently.,[/p][/*][*][p]Bring up the Collections Screen with J to view all of your available choices. You can see all of the ones available in the game, including ones you haven't yet acquired. If you haven't yet unlocked it, it will be faded. If you have unlocked it, just click on it to equip it!,[/p][/*][*][p]Exotics work a little differently. You "unlock" them as soon as you get them for the first time in-game by looting them. Until then, they will be shown with "???" to show that you don't know about them yet. Clicking on an Exotic on this screen doesn't equip it, you still do that in your inventory.,[/p][/*][*][p]So now the Collections Screen can act not only as a handy place to choose what cosmetics to equip, it's also a place to see what you haven't yet discovered in-game -- so get out there and do some looting!,[/p][/*][/list][h2]Crafting [/h2][p]New in this test is the Crafting System (U)! The Crafting System adds a new dimension to Wyld Land by giving you ways to get guaranteed drops from bosses as well as replace Exotics you might have...ahem...accidentally...lost during your adventures. In the future we may also add additional crafting recipes such as potions which give a temporary boost to your stats.[/p][list][*][p]To access the Crafting Menu, just press the U key. You'll see a list of Recipes that as well as their requirements.,[/p][/*][*][p]Recipes require ingredients from a variety of sources, including world drops (such as Wyld Essence), boss-specific drops, harvestables (now found throughout the Overworld), and fish. Explore everywhere to find everything you need!,[/p][/*][*][p]In addiiton to crafting Wyld Luck-type items, each boss in the game now has a Favor, which is a special type of Luck item specific to that boss. By collecting a large number of the boss-specific drop as well as other rare ingredients, you can craft e.g. Destructor's Favor. You can use this item after killing the Destructor and you will be guaranteed to get a drop off of its specific loot table for an item with a <15% chance of dropping (so basically, pets and exotics). This can be used to supplement your normal grind on that boss to give you a higher chance of getting that rare loot.,[/p][/*][*][p]If you have unlocked an Exotic item in the Collections screen, you will also find a recipe for it in the Crafting screen. Again, crafting it will require a large number of the boss-specific drop for the boss that drops that item, as well as other rare ingredients -- but this now gives you a path so you can recover your Exotic items that you might have lost without needing to rely solely on grinding the boss and hoping for your luck to come through.,[/p][/*][*][p]Wyld Luck, Refined Wyld Luck, and and Corrupted Wyld Luck no longer drop from monsters but instead are now craftable items.,[/p][/*][*][p]In addition, now every boss in the game has a unique boss drop that you can collect when you kill that boss. Note that these are more likely to drop when taking on the boss at higher levels.,[/p][/*][*][p]Armor Parts and Weapon Parts now drop more frequently when you destroy your unneeded weapons and armor, but you'll get more if you are destroying higher-rarity, higher-tier gear.,[/p][/*][/list][p]In the future, we anticipate that some of these items, such as Wyld Essence, Refined Wyld Essence, and Armor and Weapon Parts, will be tradable, but the trading system isn't quite in yet. Stay tuned![/p][h2]Fishing[/h2][p]New in this test is the Fishing system. Now all of the water throughout Wyld Land is teeming with fish just waiting for you to catch shoot them! To begin, open up your Crafting screen and create a Fishing Lure. Then, just equip that lure to your Active Item slot, go near some water, and use the item. The lure will be used up from your inventory, and then a short while later, fish will start flying up! Shoot them to catch them and put them into your inventory.[/p][list][*][p]Note that the lure you are using, the type of biome your are in, as well as the tier of that biome all affect what fish are available to catch.,[/p][/*][*][p]There are currently 5 fish types in the game, with plans to add more!,[/p][/*][*][p]Your lure is used up when you fish, but if you have a lot of lures in your inventory, we'll pull from your inventory [i]first[/i] so you don't have to keep re-equipping your lure until you're out of them.,[/p][/*][*][p]Craft higher-level lures luke the Advanced Lure and the Wyld Lure to catch rarer fish like the Volcano Trout!,[/p][/*][/list][h2]Achievements [/h2][p]The Achievements Screen (Y) has received an overhaul as part of the new engine release. In particular, you should now find it easier to quickly navigate the large list of Acheievements, with an overall indicator of progress for ones you're workign on, as well as a button to click to show additional details if you want to drill-down and check progress on a specific one. Note that once you have Claimed an Achievement Reward, if that reward includes a Title, you now equip the Title from the Collections Screen, not the Achievements screen. [b]Tuning Changes[/b] We've made some changes to the game's tuning, including:[/p][list][*][p]New Elite versions of many mobs, including Bomb Bot, Assassin, Heavy Slicer, and others have been added to the game. You will see these versions of the enemies in higher-tier areas of the Overworld, higher-tier dungeons, and Corrupted Dungeons.,[/p][/*][*][p]The Double-Barrel Shotgun now correctly has a maximum distance the bullets will travel similar to other shotguns.,[/p][/*][*][p]The Leech spike has been changed. Now instead of healing you when you deal damage, this Spike grants a chance to attach Digital Leeches to enemies. These are little green flashing things that will fall off the enemies when you attack them, and then after a short time explode, dealing damage to all enemies nearby.,[/p][/*][*][p]We now have the ability to specify that Spikes should only be available for certain gun archetypes. In particular, the [b]Deadly Accuracy[/b] and [b]Refundable[/b] Spikes will no longer function for Shotguns and Rocket Launchers. If you have existing guns with those Spikes, they will simply do nothing now; those spikes will no longer appear on drops for those weapons moving forward.,[/p][/*][*][p]The amount of damage absorbed by [b]Pain Converter[/b] has been reduced from 50% to 35%.,[/p][/*][*][p]The potency of the heal from [b]Frenemies[/b] has been reduced by about 20%.,[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Miscellaneous[/b][/h3][list][*][p]There is a new status effect icon that will show for bosses when they are in an invulnerable phase. You will see it appear above the boss as well as on the boss' healthbar at the top of the screen.,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the Bomb Bot wasn't exploding properly even when it got close to you.,[/p][/*][*][p]The Summoner enemy has been reworked, with a new sprite for the Summoner as well as its minions, as well as an attack of its own to keep you on your toes. Also, the Ghouls that the Summoner creats should no longer be unable to attack you near walls.,[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked some of the server-side bullet collision logic which should allow us to have a lot more enemies on-screen at once firing at the player.,[/p][/*][*][p]The Alpha Grind achievement is no longer available to be earned if you didn't already complete it previously.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p]

notes.title: Wyld Land Beta Test 2 Launching June 27th
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello Runners![/h3]

[b]The second beta test for Wyld Land will go live on June 27th and the game will run until July 11th![/b]

The beta test will be available here on Steam and in your browser through [url=https://wyld.land/]our website[/url]. This is an open beta test, so everyone is welcome to join!

Thank you to everyone who joined in on our first beta test. We received a lot of positive feedback and reports for bugs. Since that previous beta test, we have been focusing on developing a new engine to reduce the amount of networking bugs alongside developing a ton of new content.

We will not be wiping data for this test, so if you played during the last beta test, you will be able to continue from where you left off with your account. This is important because the key feature we are going to be adding for this beta test is our raids!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45342732/92959b99fb0e2bef94c2d9e8023a4baf63f88d9d.png[/img]

Our first raid will be content for parties of 6 end-game players. Our raids will combine all of the mechanics we currently have in our bullet hell gameplay with MMO raid mechanics that require players to work together.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45342732/9042c2fbd14f3a3faf4a5591189f932f2db5aaff.png[/img]

We will have at least one raid added for this beta test. We will provide more details on how to enter the raid when the test goes live. If you are looking for a group to run our new raids with, you can use the in-game chat to find party members or join the [url=discord.gg/6GXWp8UPf5]Discord[/url] and ask there!

We are excited to see groups take on this content in the next beta test! We will be listening closely to feedback to tune the difficulty and mechanics of our raids for the future, so please let us know your thoughts after you have the chance to challenge a raid!



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45342732/d9646f581ac7fcafefd9bc95b27e5405f1a44e93.png[/img]

We are also planning on adding more quests! We do not have an exact count yet but we will leave a few hints on how to start the new quests before the next test goes live.

Quests in Wyld Land will consist of finding and talking to NPCs and completing the challenges they have for unique rewards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45342732/38ecec3d7c6845123a96b8be7c54c45f1f1a991a.png[/img]

With new quests comes a bit of story and lore. Wyld Land is never going to be an MMO that forces you to sit through cutscenes. But we've been developing a bit more background story that we will sprinkle in through quests, NPC dialogue, and item descriptions.

We are still cooking up rewards for quests, we really want them to feel worth your time. Quests should provide a nice break from the dungeon grind but we want the reward to match the time you put in.




[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45342732/3f0a6391ed02ec2dbcae37c9c4faa5091d32fad4.png[/img]

Fishing is one mechanic that is a bit different from what is in the game currently. It is still in development, but we want to at least test this feature for this beta test. There will not be the full amount of content for the beta test but hopefully it should give you a small taste of what is to come.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45342732/02acf32fcd08ecfef7dca2023c622f1c4aa6710d.png[/img]

Fishing is one of those MMO features that helps fill out the world and provides things to do outside of combat.

Still, we are goin to put our own bullet hell spin on fishing, so stay tuned for more details! We will likely keep most of the fishing rewards cosmetic, as we do not want it to be something that has to be done to progress.

Crafting is another feature that might show up in the next beta test, as well as a Collections menu, where you can view and select cosmetics. These are both still a WIP so they may or may not show up in full, but we are hoping to get them in to test in some capacity.

This beta test will also serve as a way for us to test out the new engine. We have moved our game engine from Unity to Heaps to help give us more control and reduce networking bugs. A new engine means new bugs, so join the [url=discord.gg/6GXWp8UPf5]Discord[/url] and report issues you find to our feedback channel. It really will help us make the game better especially as we get closer to launching the game.

Raids, fishing, a new engine, crafting, and a collections menu is a nice bit of new content, so we will be making more development logs on [url=https://www.youtube.com/@NullEq]YouTube[/url] as we lead up to the next beta test on June 27th to explain more about them.

To keep up with development, you can also follow us across social media:

[url=discord.gg/6GXWp8UPf5]Discord[/url]
[url=https://www.youtube.com/@NullEq]YouTube[/url]
[url=https://x.com/WyldLandGame]Twitter/X[/url]
[url=https://bsky.app/profile/wyldland.bsky.social]BlueSky[/url]
[url=https://www.tiktok.com/@wyldland]TikTok[/url]

While you wait, the best way to support us right now is to Wishlist Wyld Land right here on Steam.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3387720/Wyld_Land/

Thanks for supporting the development of Wyld Land- see you in game again soon, Runner!

-The Wyld Land Team

notes.title: Beta Test Ends Soon!
notes.notes:
Hello Runners!

Thank you to everyone who participated in our first Open Beta Test! We had over 3,000 players join in during the first week alone, and it was great getting to play alongside many of you! It was fun watching new players discover the game and seeing the hardest content we've created cleared by veterans- that just means we'll need to keep adding to the challenge!

[h3]This Open Beta Test (and Steam Demo) will go down on Monday, March 31st at 12 PM CST.[/h3]

We have gotten a lot of great feedback from players, and we feel now is a good time to take things offline so we can focus on our engine, fixing bugs, and adding to new content to the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45342732/ad19e29cc36553433e411f4192239e119ab61d88.gif[/img]

If you have played Wyld Land during this test, please let us know about your experience! We'll be working on new content, but we're also taking in the input from players. Even if you played for just a bit and decided not to continue, we'd like to know why! 

Please let us know what you loved, what you hated, and everything in-between in the comments here, or join our [url=discord.gg/6GXWp8UPf5]Discord[/url] to talk to us there.

We'll keep you updated here on Steam and on Discord as we develop content while the game is down. There will be more beta tests before launch, but it might be a a bit of time until the next one as we work on stuff under the hood.

If you haven't already, please leave us a Wishlist! This helps us out and will notify you when we do actually launch!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3387720/Wyld_Land/

See you next beta test, thanks for playing!

The Wyld Land Team

notes.title: Roll20 co-creator reveals bullet hell MMO Wyld Land with a demo up now
notes.notes:
One of the co-creators of the popular Roll20 virtual tabletop Roll20 has revealed Wyld Land, a free to play bullet hell MMO.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/03/roll20-co-creator-reveals-bullet-hell-mmo-wyld-land-with-a-demo-up-now/

notes.title: Demo Live Now!
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello Runners![/h3]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3387720/Wyld_Land/][h3]The Wyld Land Demo is now live!

Visit the main Steam Store page to play![/h3][/url]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3387720/Wyld_Land/

Wyld Land is now officially in open beta! Thank you to everyone who played during the Alpha and helped contribute with feedback and bug reports.

If you are new around here- welcome!

Wyld Land is our 2D bullet-hell roguelite MMO. If you've played games like Realm of the Mad God or Enter the Gungeon, then you've come to the right place.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45342732/e2ec9a6cfd0c4d34d812ba40f6ae8bbb8d136317.gif[/img]

You'll explore a dangerous world corrupted by ancient technology, dodge waves of bullets, collect powerful gear, explore ever-changing dungeons, and uncover the mysteries of a fallen civilization.

[b]Wyld Land is first and foremost a free-to-play MMO.[/b] You can play right here on Steam, or you can actually play in your browser on basically any PC. [url=https://wyld.land/]If your someone who would like that, simply head over to our website to play in your browser by clicking here.[/url]

We're building Wyld Land to be about collecting loot, slaying tough bosses, and playing with your friends. Wyld Land won't be about killing your wallet. There will be a non-predatory cosmetic cash shop, but you'll be able to enjoy the experience completely free-to-play!

If this sounds good, you can hop into the demo right now to play!

You can also join the Discord and follow us across social media to keep up with development:

[url=discord.gg/6GXWp8UPf5]Discord[/url]
[url=https://www.youtube.com/@NullEq]YouTube[/url]
[url=https://x.com/WyldLandGame]Twitter/X[/url]
[url=https://bsky.app/profile/wyldland.bsky.social]BlueSky[/url]
[url=https://www.tiktok.com/@wyldland]TikTok[/url]

While we don't have the cash shop avaiable in the demo, the best way to support the development of Wyld Land currently is to Wishlist the game here on Steam (yes, it really does help!) and invite your friends to play with you.

We will have a few updates with new bosses, content, and more during the beta phase, so we will keep you up to date with patch notes and development updates during the entire beta!

Thanks for supporting the development of Wyld Land- see you in game, Runner!

-The Wyld Land Team
